source: DARPA Transparent Computing Engagement 3, TC_Ground_Truth_Report_E3_Update.pdf (Kudu Dynamics, TA5.1), linked from https://github.com/darpa-i2o/Transparent-Computing/blob/master/README-E3.md
note: Transcribed from the report's CADETS sections. Times are the report's local times (US/Eastern). All IP addresses in the report are fictional (README-E3). Paths are as written in the report; a bare file name was dropped by the operator console into the implant's working directory (usually /tmp).

Nginx_Backdoor_06.summary: Nginx exploited by HTTP POST; loaderDrakon connects to the operator console; implant /tmp/vUgefal elevated to root; netrecon to 154.145.113.18 fails and to 61.167.39.128 succeeds; libdrakon dropped at /var/log/devc; injection into sshd (PID 809) fails and the host panics.

ips.154.145.113.18: netrecon target (failed; listed as 154.143.113.18 in the report's address table)

Nginx_Backdoor_11.summary: Nginx exploited on the first attempt; drakon runs in nginx memory; libdrakon dropped as sendmail (failed) and grain; injection of /tmp/grain into PID 802 fails and the host crashes at 15:15.

Nginx_Backdoor_12.summary: Nginx re-exploited; micro APT dropped as tmux-1002 and minions but elevation fails; drakon executable XIM elevated to root with C2 to 53.158.101.118; micro APT run unprivileged (sendmail, main, test) with C2 to 192.113.144.28; port scans of eight internal hosts; the operator console connection is left open.

Nginx_Backdoor_13.summary: Attacker reconnects to the connection left open on 04-12, then re-exploits nginx; drakon executable pEja72mA elevated to root with C2 to 53.158.101.118; libdrakon copies (eWq10bVcx, memhelp.so, eraseme, done.so) injected into sshd PID 20691 three times, all failing; sshd becomes unresponsive.

ips.128.55.12.73: local address used for the HTTP request (nc -s 25.159.96.207 128.55.12.73 80)
ips.78.205.235.65: nginx connection listed in the report

not_attacks_on_cadets.postfix_phishing_relay: Section 4.1: phishing e-mails to other hosts were sent through the postfix server hosted on CADETS from 62.83.155.175 (2018-04-06 14:40 and 15:02, 04-09 13:19 and 14:19, 04-10 12:28). Not an attack on the CADETS host; unlabelled in every label set.
